summary.en-US: Create concise image descriptions for blind and low-vision readers with a provider you choose.

description.en-US: Paste or explicitly select an image, optionally add context, and generate a concise description suitable for alt text. Image Description connects directly to an OpenAI-compatible local or remote provider configured by the user. Images and descriptions are not persisted.

version.approval_notes: The submitted extension is built from TypeScript with Vite. Reproduction instructions are in SOURCE_BUILD.md in the accompanying source archive. This release supports desktop Firefox only.
